findings.reason: the gate does not prove the deliverable's second half, so the same defect the section exists to close survives in the write-path case the plan itself names.
findings.text: §22's deliverable re-roots "a manifest path or write path inside the queued run's own directory", but the three done-when cases assert only the manifest path (case 1: launched manifest_path and prompt; case 2: an external --manifest kept elsewhere; case 3: the brief path unchanged) and the single negative control reverts only "the queued manifest path carried over unchanged", so a builder that re-roots the manifest path alone passes the gate while a node whose write paths default under the queued run's directory keeps delivering into it

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `_node_from_pointer` (reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:74), `_supervisor_manifest_path` (reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:2612), `_resolved_write_paths` (reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py:1756) and dispatch_plan.py:477 all resolve, and the cited measurement run r-20261014T080250692824 exists with admitted_from naming r-20261014T080011715849.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §22's deliverable re-roots both a manifest path and a write path out of the queued run's own directory, but its three cases and its single negative control exercise only the manifest path.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §22's gate and its negative control are logged under the run directory, a durable path rather than a session scratchpad or a node-local temp directory.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §22 introduces no plan labels, stage names, ticket numbers or version tags, and names its mechanism (the queued run's directory) rather than a tracker entry.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the stated root cause matches the cited evidence: the live pointer for r-20261014T080250692824 still carries a manifest_path under the queued run r-20261014T080011715849 and admitted_from naming that queued run, and _launch_queued passes the rebuilt node to dispatch, which reads the non-empty path as caller-named, so the mechanism runs on the real path with _launch_queued named.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §22 carries one deliverable: a relaunched request takes its run-directory defaults from its launched run id.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §22 declares its ordering with §20 ("shares queue_admission.py with §20, so it is dispatched after §20 lands") and its relationship to §9's brief path; the cited plan a-run-has-one-live-writer and its §3 both resolve.
